decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch is close to the firm's core craft of arches and lighting, so the workshop can read early results and refine the line, and it was shown prominently on the home page.
A one-tier Christmas pyramid sits squarely in the firm's established knowledge base and is featured on the home page, making it easy to assimilate and improve.

The electronic music box is distant from the firm's woodcraft and the firm lacks in-house R&D, but it is presented as a flagship line with several models and given home-page prominence, so management will likely persist for now.
This motif platform is a peripheral accessory for an electronic product far from the firm's knowledge, only mentioned on the website, and the firm has little R&D with which to learn from its results.

The Christmas motif platform is also a distant, low-visibility accessory, although its seasonal motif links somewhat to the firm's craft, so its continuation is uncertain and dropping it frees resources for the core business.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on the firm's pyramid tradition and is featured on the home page, so the firm can readily interpret its results and improve it.
